Why did Nikola Tesla invent the internet

Nikola Tesla did not invent the internet. The internet as we know it today was developed through a series of technological advancements and collaborations over several decades. The internet was created as a way to connect computers and share information globally. While Tesla made significant contributions to the field of electrical engineering and technology, his work was not directly related to the invention of the internet.
